image.name: webcord
image.description: [WebCord](https://github.com/SpacingBat3/WebCord) can be summarized as a pack of security and privacy hardenings, Discord features reimplementations, Electron / Chromium / Discord bugs workarounds, stylesheets, internal pages and wrapped https://discord.com page, designed to conform with ToS as much as it is possible (or hide the changes that might violate it from Discord's eyes).

changelog.desc: Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Use Wayland ozone platform fixes scaling and acceleration.
Switch to Selkies base image, HTTPS IS NOW REQUIRED.
Update chromium launch options to improve performance.
Update Readme with new env vars and ingest proper PWA icon.
Update bash wrappers to cleanup and detect seccomp.
Add fonts-noto-color-emoji for better emoji support.
Bundle Chromium to provide browser for opening links, etc.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores program settings.

ports.desc: WebCord desktop gui HTTP, must be proxied.

custom.name: shm-size
custom.desc: This is needed for electron applications to function properly.

image.title: Webcord
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  webcord:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/webcord:latest
    container_name: webcord
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=webcord \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/webcord:latest
